title: Legislation and the Regulatory State: the semester
shortTitle: How the LRS course fits together
summary: The course follows lawmaking and statutory interpretation, the legal structure of agencies, agency procedure, and judicial review of administrative action.
notes: Start with the corrected syllabus and its 26 class groups. Each assigned item has a source-location ledger. Case accounts explain the supplied excerpts; historical doctrines, separate opinions, and later casebook discussions retain their own scope. The three readings not on file are listed by name in the reading-plans subject. The subject hierarchy gives each record a stable home, while explained relationships and concept indexes connect accounts across the whole course.
